title: REMOVE TIMING BELT CASE WITH WATER PUMP THROUGH MEASURE OIL CLEARANCE

content.description: Illustration showing timing belt case with water pump and bolt locations marked with arrows

content.text: 12. REMOVE TIMING BELT CASE WITH WATER PUMP
Remove the eight bolts and two nuts and remove the timing belt case and gaskets.

content.description: Illustration showing oil pump drive shaft removal procedure with belt and pulley system

items: (a) Remove the bolt holding the oil pump drive shaft.
(b) While turning the oil pump drive shaft, slowly pull it out so as not to damage the bearing.

content.description: Illustration showing oil pump assembly location and mounting bolts

items: (a) Remove the union bolt and nut and remove the oil pump outlet pipe.
(b) Remove bolt holding the oil pump, and remove the oil pump assembly.

content.description: Illustration showing connecting rod with dial gauge measuring thrust clearance

content.text: Using a dial gauge, measure the thrust clearance.
If clearance is greater than maximum, replace the connecting rod and/or crankshaft.

content.description: Illustration showing connecting rod caps being marked and removed

content.text: 17. REMOVE CONNECTING ROD CAPS AND MEASURE OIL CLEARANCE

items: (a) Using a punch or numbering stamp, mark the connecting rods and caps to ensure correct reassembly.
